definitions.explanation: A racquet sport in which players hit a shuttlecock across a net. One of the most popular sports in Japan at the school and recreational level.

examples.japanese: バドミントン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バドミントン⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I joined the school badminton club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧バドミントン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: I worked up a sweat playing badminton with friends at the gym.

notes:
From English 'badminton.' One of the most popular club activities (⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧) in Japanese middle and high schools. Japan has produced world-class players, and the sport receives significant attention during the Olympics.
